descriptors: Speaks at length without noticeable effort or loss of coherence
May demonstrate language-related hesitation at times or some repetition
Uses a range of discourse markers naturally and flexibly
Uses vocabulary resource flexibly to discuss a variety of topics
Uses some less common and idiomatic vocabulary and shows some awareness of collocation

Frequently produces error-free sentences, though some grammatical mistakes persist
Good control of complex clauses and conditional forms
Shows all the positive features of Band 6 and some features of Band 8

Is easy to understand throughout, with accent having minimal impact on intelligibility
